    Our Story

    About N&G

    N&G Poultry Supply Store was established in 2020 at Market Site, Donsol, Sorsogon. We started with a clear mission: to give local poultry raisers — from backyard farmers to commercial operations — access to reliable, high-quality supplies at honest prices.

    Our name reflects the values we stand by: Nurturing your flock with the very best, and Guaranteeing quality you can always count on. We are proud to serve the community of Donsol and the surrounding areas of Sorsogon.

    Every product on our shelves is thoughtfully chosen. Every customer who walks through our doors is treated like a neighbor — because that's exactly what you are.
